description:
Add the git module's query for the commits that touched one path, backed by one `git log` process.

## Background

- Document history walks the whole history from `HEAD` in libgit2 (`get_file_history`, `crates/jit/src/commands/document.rs:864-914`), so its cost grows with project history (`@/charter/D-19`).
- `git log -z --format=… -- <path>` lists the commits touching a path newest first, applies git's default history simplification, and can use commit-graph filters.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `GitCheckout::file_history(path)` runs one `git log` over the path and returns commits newest first with full id, author name, commit time and message.
- [hard] REQ-02: The behaviour suite covers an added, a changed and a deleted path, a merge identical to one parent, a message with newlines, and counts one process per query.

## Notes

- Written against the code as it stands after the changes this one follows; line citations name current code.
title: Path history query in the git module
